constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: rain runs down a bus window at night while the city slides past outside
Creative addition: a low, muffled bus-engine hum and distant wet-traffic hiss provide diegetic sound texture.
Creative addition: passing streetlamp light is reflected in the glass and smears into a long golden streak behind the moving droplet.
Creative addition: droplets merge and leave thin, trembling trails on the pane.

description.text: Night presses close beyond a rain-streaked bus window. The pane fills the vertical frame with beads, flecks, and broken trails of water; beyond it, out-of-focus city lights and wet asphalt slide sideways in soft bands of amber, white, and reflected red. Droplets cling to the glass, some trembling at the edge of release while others merge and hesitate before dragging thin lines through the condensation. The pane carries a faint grain of grime and cold mist, catching each passing glow in small shivers as fresh rain keeps arriving from above.
A rain-covered bus window dominates the night scene, with droplets clustered across the glass and blurred city lights drifting horizontally behind it.
Soft rain patters against the glass; a low, muffled engine hum and distant wet-traffic hiss sit underneath.
Several beads merge and begin to crawl downward, widening into thin, wavering trails as reflected lights slip past outside.
New drops strike the upper pane and scatter tiny points of light; the older trails bend slightly with the motion beyond the glass.

Extreme close on one swollen raindrop near the centre of the pane. It trembles at the point of release, holding a tiny inverted city inside its curve, then breaks loose and races diagonally downward. Behind it, a passing streetlamp reflection stretches into a long wavering golden streak, bending through the wet trail. Around the drop, smaller beads quiver and slide; the dark glass turns the outside world into slow, slick ribbons of light and colour.
A single large droplet hangs near the centre of the pane, its curve holding a distorted glint of the city.
A single drop ticks faintly on the glass, while wet traffic hisses somewhere beyond the window.
The droplet breaks free and accelerates diagonally, smearing a streetlamp reflection into a long golden streak.
The trail trembles and elongates; smaller beads shiver around it and follow in short, broken lines.
The glass dims between passing lights, leaving the streaked water to catch only faint silver highlights at the edge of the frame.

soundscape: Soft rain ticks and patters against the glass over a low, muffled bus-engine hum, with distant wet traffic hissing beyond the window.
